sentences.text: Hiromichi Matsuda, born November 30, 1971, is President, Representative Director and CEO of KDDI Corporation, a role he assumed in April 2025 alongside the post of Executive Director of the Corporate and Marketing Communications Sector.

sentences.quote: Matsuda is currently Managing Executive Officer, Director, and Chief Digital Officer and joined KDDI in 1996. He replaces current CEO Makoto Takahashi, who has been appointed Chairman of KDDI.
sentences.text: He joined KDDI in 1996 and succeeded Makoto Takahashi, who became chairman.

Earlier roles at the company included Executive Officer from April 2020, Deputy Executive Director of the Personal Business Sector from April 2023, Director from June 2023, and Managing Executive Officer and Chief Digital Officer from April 2024.
